answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 35214 Country: India Title: My parents are searching since a long time to buy a good house Question: My parents are searching since a long time to buy a good house. Please suggest a dua which will help us find a good and affordable house. Answer ID: 35214 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1727/1727/M=1432) Keep on looking for good house. And keep on supplicating Almighty Allah after the five salah for this purpose. Also keep on reciting Ayatul Kursi 3-3 times with durood 11-11 times before and after in the morning and evening. If Allah wills, you shall achieve your goal. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
